# Punjabi Music Collaboration Platform - Design System

## Brand Identity

### Color Palette
- **Primary Saffron**: #FF9933 - Traditional Punjabi color, used for primary actions and highlights
- **Vibrant Green**: #339933 - Represents growth and prosperity, used for success states
- **Bold Red**: #CC0033 - Energy and passion, used for urgent actions and notifications
- **Bright Blue**: #3366CC - Trust and professionalism, used for secondary actions
- **Light Cream**: #FFF5E1 - Warm background color, maintains readability
- **Charcoal Grey**: #333333 - Primary text color for high contrast
- **Soft Grey**: #999999 - Secondary text and subtle elements

### Typography
- **Headings & Buttons**: Montserrat (Bold, SemiBold, Medium, Regular)
- **Body Text**: Poppins (Medium, Regular, Light)
- **Punjabi Script**: Noto Sans Punjabi (Regular, Medium, Bold)

### Cultural Design Elements
- Traditional Punjabi motifs (Phulkari patterns, geometric designs)
- Rounded corners (8px, 12px, 16px) reflecting Punjabi architectural elements
- Vibrant gradients combining saffron and green
- Subtle pattern overlays for backgrounds

### Mobile Specifications
- **Target Resolution**: 390 x 844 px (iPhone 12/13/14 standard)
- **Safe Area**: 44px top, 34px bottom
- **Touch Targets**: Minimum 44px x 44px
- **Grid System**: 8px base unit

### Component Guidelines
- **Cards**: 12px border radius, subtle shadows
- **Buttons**: 8px border radius, clear hierarchy
- **Input Fields**: 8px border radius, clear focus states
- **Icons**: 24px standard, 32px for primary actions
